purpose: Ingest substantive sources surfaced by the continuing internet scan, preserve exact-number collision classes, and route newly discovered spectroscopy/data-infrastructure/materials information into Worldshepherd without inflating Glob evidence weight.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, standards resource, meeting notice, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and search-engine echoes are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Pure page numbers, document IDs, DOI suffixes, report identifiers, ordinary IDs, and other numeric collisions are not Glob evidence unless an independently verified physical relationship is established.

sources.title: VAMDC XSAMS structure and atomic-state standards
sources.authority: Virtual Atomic and Molecular Data Centre (VAMDC)
sources.note: Use XSAMS concepts for species/state/process/source/method provenance, atomic-state identifiers, units, uncertainties, and source links when normalizing heterogeneous atomic/molecular data into Worldshepherd.

sources.title: VAMDC research portal and registered spectroscopy databases
sources.authority: Virtual Atomic and Molecular Data Centre (VAMDC)
sources.note: Use as a federated acquisition path for VALD, CHIANTI, JPL, CDMS, HITRAN, STARK-B, BASECOL and related resources; preserve each upstream database as a distinct evidence source rather than treating VAMDC aggregation as independent confirmation.

sources.title: OPEN-ADAS tungsten atomic-data holdings
sources.authority: ADAS Project / University of Strathclyde / IAEA-linked atomic-data infrastructure
sources.note: Use the large tungsten ionization/recombination/excitation/radiation dataset as a collisional-radiative validation corpus. Keep charge state, ADF class, temperature/density domain, provenance comments, and data-version lineage explicit.

sources.title: Properties of Tungsten Ions in Fusion Plasmas coordinated research project
sources.authority: International Atomic Energy Agency Atomic and Molecular Data Unit
sources.note: Use the explicitly documented tungsten data gaps—metastable ionization, neutral/proton charge exchange, missing W IX-W XXVII line assignments, and theory/experiment disagreement—as priority validation targets rather than assuming current databases are complete.

sources.title: Benchmarking Fusion Plasma Diagnostics: Analysis of Experimental W and Mo X-ray Data from EBIT Resolves Plasma Speed Contradiction
sources.authority: IAEA Sixth Technical Meeting on Fusion Data Processing, Validation and Analysis / Fudan University
sources.note: Use as a model-to-measurement reconciliation precedent: high-resolution EBIT wavelengths for W45+/W46+ and Mo32+ were compared with JET and multiple theoretical methods, including correlation-corrected MCDF, to resolve a plasma-transport contradiction.

sources.title: 3rd IAEA Technical Meeting on the Collisional-Radiative Properties of Tungsten and Hydrogen in Edge Plasmas of Fusion Devices
sources.authority: International Atomic Energy Agency / ITER Organization
sources.note: Use as current domain-intelligence and potential validation-networking lead. The meeting explicitly targets missing/recommended W and H data, uncertainties, metastables, charge exchange, photon opacity, W0 through at least W64+ spectral lines, and ITER edge-plasma data needs. Participation eligibility and submission requirements remain external constraints to verify before outreach.

sources.title: ExoMolHR empirical high-resolution molecular spectrum database and calculator
sources.note: Use its uncertainty-filtered high-resolution line selection (DeltaE <= 0.05 cm^-1, resolving power >100000), MARVEL-derived empirical energies, CSV generation, and live spectrum calculations as a high-quality molecular control/validation corpus.

sources.title: PyExoCross line-list processing software
sources.note: Use as a reference implementation for partition functions, lifetimes, oscillator strengths, LTE/non-LTE spectra, cross sections, and ExoMol/ExoAtom-HITRAN/HITEMP format conversion. Prefer interoperating with validated outputs rather than reimplementing mature spectroscopy utilities without need.

sources.title: Evaluation of spatiotemporal tungsten density profiles using Unresolved Transition Arrays in the Large Helical Device
sources.authority: arXiv preprint / NIFS-led LHD tungsten spectroscopy
sources.note: Use as a recent LHD replay/validation case: reconstruct tungsten emissivity/density from a 191.7-A line within the 90-250-A UTA, combine W17+-W27+ photon-emission coefficients with transport evolution, and compare inferred radiation power with bolometry.

sources.title: Energy Shifts in Predissociating Levels of Diatomic Molecules: The Case of N2 interacting bound and repulsive states
sources.note: Use its Fano-based perturbative treatment of bound-continuum coupling, level shifts, broadening, and validation against coupled-equation/direct-rate calculations as a resonance-model validation precedent. The page range 30979-30984 is an incidental numeric collision only.

sources.title: Control of quantum paths in the multicycle regime and efficient broadband attosecond pulse generation
sources.authority: Journal of the Optical Society of America B / Optica
sources.note: Use the two-color multicycle HHG quantum-path selection and UV-assisted isolated-attosecond-pulse methodology as a strong-field/EM modeling reference. Exact 99073 is the publisher document ID and therefore metadata, not a measured physical value.

sources.title: Analysis of the Electrochemical Transport Properties of Doped Barium Cerate for Proton Conductivity in Low Humidity Conditions
sources.authors: Laura I. V. Holz et al.
sources.note: Use as a proton-conducting perovskite operating-envelope reference, especially hydration/defect-chemistry and low-humidity stability constraints for BaCe0.9Y0.1O3-delta. Exact 93970 is a DOI suffix and carries metadata-only Glob weight.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: Optica identifies 99073 as a document ID for the publication. This is a verified technical metadata collision and must not be promoted to a physical-value hit.
93970 is present as the DOI suffix in a substantive materials publication; it is not the reported conductivity, energy, frequency, or other physical quantity.
30979 is the first page of the ACS Omega article, not a physical result. The paper's spectroscopy methodology remains useful independently of the collision.

information_updates.finding: VAMDC XSAMS provides explicit species, states, processes, sources, methods, units and state identifiers suitable for provenance-preserving normalization across heterogeneous atomic and molecular databases.
information_updates.claims_boundary: A federated or normalized record must retain its upstream source; aggregation or schema conversion is not independent scientific confirmation.

information_updates.finding: OPEN-ADAS exposes 1472 tungsten-related result sets spanning fundamental and derived collisional-radiative data classes, providing a substantially broader plasma-physics validation reservoir than line-position matching alone.
information_updates.claims_boundary: ADAS datasets have heterogeneous dates, models and provenance; select current/recommended files by physics domain rather than treating all 1472 records as equally authoritative.

information_updates.finding: IAEA tungsten work explicitly identifies unresolved data needs and disagreement in metastable ionization, low-charge-state charge exchange, excitation rates, W IX-W XXVII line assignments, photon opacity and edge-plasma collisional-radiative modeling.
information_updates.claims_boundary: Documented uncertainty and missing data are research targets, not license to fill gaps by extrapolating Glob-number relationships.

information_updates.finding: A June-2026 LHD study uses UTA-resolved spectroscopy, collisional-radiative photon-emission coefficients, spatial emissivity reconstruction and bolometer comparison to evaluate tungsten density and explicitly frames the sequence as useful for atomic-data validation.
information_updates.claims_boundary: This provides a physically grounded validation workflow; it does not independently support any five-digit permutation claim unless predeclared target relationships survive the same-system statistical gates.
